name: ntfyx
description: Encrypted phone replies and Session conversations for coding agents. Get completion alerts, answer choices or text on iPhone and Android, and continue with verified replies.

interface.shortDescription: Phone replies for your coding agent
interface.longDescription: Keep a task’s updates and questions in one encrypted conversation. Answer with buttons or text on iPhone, Android or an authorized Web Inbox. Includes local MCP and a phone-first question skill. Claude Code also bridges AskUserQuestion; Codex native question prompts are not intercepted. Requires Ntfyx CLI 0.1.3+ and a paired phone. Tool execution approvals have a separate compatibility matrix.
defaultPrompt: Ask me a test question on my phone with Ntfyx.
Keep this task’s updates and questions in one Ntfyx Session.
